States that thm:p02-decidability and SAT/TAUT of def:p02-sat-taut act on finite encoded inputs over the countable p_n coding (def:p02-w02-p02-016-inputs); proves that a finite input involves only finitely many atoms; proves a choice-free transfer of every finite input over an arbitrary P into that coding, with answers independent of the renaming, reducing each question to TAUT/SAT membership of one encoded string settled by 2^k rows; proves that for uncountable P there is no injection of Form(P) into finite bit strings and no enumeration of Form(P); and states in a proofboundary, linked to thm:p02-fbc-completeness, thm:p02-arbitrary-prop-completeness and thm:p02-arbitrary-prop-compactness-bpi, that the BPI-relative theorem supplies no decision procedure, enumeration or encoding of Form(P). The countable infinite-premise undecidability is taken from thm:p02-w02-p02-018-limits(1), proved in the sibling w02-p02-018 annex. The countable Choice-free distinction remains at its pre-existing places (propositional-metatheory-supplement.tex 37-42, 70-72; free-boolean-algebra-and-completeness.tex 16-23) and is restated in the regimes table. Reaches the reader only after the driver insertions under placement (lead action).
